Day Eleven
This has to be the most unbelievable scene I’ve witnessed in my entire life.
An enormous Echoback showed up in the storm and guided its struggling brothers and sisters back into the depths of the sea, one by one.
Its powerful singing even drowned out the howling winds and thunder. It just kept singing until all the stranded Echobacks found their way back.
Watching its figure swimming through the waves, I realized that no storm lasts forever. 
Just like every storm I’ve been through, they always end with blue skies.

Day Fifteen
The storm has finally stopped.
I didn’t fail my reputation as an old sailor, just like the Echoback didn’t fail its brothers and sisters.
It brought them all back to the sea, but stayed behind... forever, on this shore.
The raft I made was too small to tow it, so I carved its tale into this stone.
I know that its bones will stand here for a very long time.

May its story be told for eternity.
May all sailors finally see their blue skies.
